name: A Walk in the Silent Street
source:
Her daily job has just ended. She is walking in the street at night going home. Someone is following her. Her fate depends on you.

[From [url=https://kirinoyastudios.itch.io/a-walk-in-the-silent-street]itch.io[/url]]
